operation.description: report writes one report (HTML, JSON and two CSVs) for the selected workspaces; with no selection it reviews every visible workspace (at most 50 per report, after the subscription filter). list_workspaces returns the inventory discovered live with Azure Resource Graph (plus APPROVED_WORKSPACES entries), paged with limit/offset. query returns filtered rows of a fresh collection of 1 to 5 workspaces. self_test writes the same four files from a built-in SIMULATED workspace without authentication or network (demos only, labelled SIMULATED).

view.description: Only for operation=query. findings exposes all checks; report findings contains failed checks only. costs exposes the Databricks cost model (headline, DBU vs infrastructure, attribution rows and optimisation signals). coverage exposes scoped source receipts. dependencies exposes OBSERVED, INFERRED and UNKNOWN nodes, edges and blind spots.

workspace_name.description: Exactly one workspace_name as returned by list_workspaces (detailed single-workspace report). When the same name exists in several subscriptions, use the prefixed key (first 8 characters of the subscription ID + '-' + name) or add subscription. "all" means every visible workspace. Mutually exclusive with workspace_names.

workspace_names.description: "all" (every visible workspace) or 1 to 50 distinct exact workspace names from list_workspaces, comma-separated without spaces, e.g. dbw-a,dbw-b,dbw-c. Mutually exclusive with workspace_name.

workload_name.description: Only for operation=query: exact local filter for cluster, job, pipeline, SQL warehouse, Unity Catalog object or resource name; no URL/path/query/command.

classification.description: Local provenance filter for view=dependencies: OBSERVED native ID/key joins, INFERRED URI/host references, or UNKNOWN blind spots.

limit.description: Requested row count for query and list_workspaces; the 3500-byte default-JSON budget may return fewer whole rows with exact paging disclosure (next_offset).

offset.description: Local offset for query and list_workspaces (use the returned next_offset); not a persistent cursor.

subscription.description: Optional subscription filter: a subscription ID or exact display name (case-insensitive) as shown by list_workspaces. Filters list_workspaces and the report/query selection. Empty = every visible subscription. Not used by self_test.
